## App Signals

Lists up to 32 named double-precision values shared by Wili Blocks, scripts and
dynamic controls. The selected signal is graphed live.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Up / Down | Select the previous or next signal |
| Left / Right | Jump five rows |
| Center | Edit the selected value |
| Gray | Set the selected value to zero |
| Yellow | Add a signal |
| Green | Remove the selected signal |
| Blue | Rename the selected signal |
| Red | Cycle the selected signal's test wave |
| Cancel | This help page |

Wave modes are off, then sine, triangle, square and sawtooth at 0.5 Hz and
2 Hz. Only one signal is wave-driven at a time.

### Serial menu

Scripting > App Signals provides Add, Remove, Rename, Set Value, Get Value,
Apply Wave and Stream. Apply Wave accepts mode 0-8. Stream accepts milliseconds;
0 stops it and positive rates below 10 are clamped to 10 ms. Each `appSignal`
event contains a name and floating-point value.

**See also:** [App Signals](../features/app-signals.md) — the console/GUI commands for this panel.
